what: When the panel becomes visible, confetti cannons at the bottom corners of the screen (3% and 97%) burst 64 pieces each (38 below width 600) at 1100~2000px/s, and three balloons float up. While the panel is visible, one piece falls from the top every .07~.13s and a balloon rises every 1.4~2.4s (2.6~3.8s if more than 200 pieces remain), up to 7. Pieces use gravity 900×.45, drag e^(−2.1~2.8·dt), 55px side sway and flipping while falling. Balloons rise at 85~125px/s, accelerating at −14/s² and swaying at 1.1Hz. When the mouse touches a balloon it pops and 28 pieces scatter at 220~620px/s. From the second pop on there are 40% as many pieces, and no new pop within 1.4 seconds

options.balloons: Max balloons floating at once, default 7 — 0 means no balloons
options.trickle: If 0, stops scattering after the burst, default 1
options.threshold: Share at which the panel counts as seen, default .25
options.--fx-party-1~6: Piece/balloon colors (CSS variables), default text, accent, pale accent, pale text + pink and gold turned from the accent
options.fx:burst: Sending this event to the panel makes it burst right away (original: the moment the lead card sits in the first case spot)

note: The drawing plate is a single canvas covering the full screen (z-index 97, clicks pass through). The original also scatters a frog logo, the number 8 and star pieces — the part uses only square, bar and dot pieces. On touch devices balloon popping is not applied

from.where: index.js party — original BirthdayParty (cannon 64 · speed 1100~2000 · gravity 900 · balloons 7 · burst 28 pieces), bursts when the first case settles into place and keeps spraying until the intro line has fully passed
